The '''Crystal Caves''' of [[Ossus/Legends|Ossus]] were a series of deep cave systems within the [[Eocho Mountains/Legends|Eocho]] [[Mountain/Legends|mountains]]. Within the caves, [[Adegan crystal/Legends|Adegan]] [[Lightsaber crystal/Legends|crystals]] were plentiful and prized by the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] for their use in [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsabers]]. During the Order's time on Ossus, [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Masters]] often sent their [[Padawan/Legends|Padawans]] into the caves as part of their [[Jedi Trials/Legends|Trial of Spirit]]. Once inside the caves, the [[Vergence/Legends|vergence]] there created a sense of unease in [[The Force/Legends|the Force]], and made those who entered feel as if they were being watched. Many Padawans claimed to have dreamlike experiences wherein their deepest vulnerabilities were laid bare.

In the rush to collect as many Adegan crystals before the [[Cron Supernova/Legends|Cron Supernova]] irradiated the [[Planet/Legends|planet]], a [[Jedi survivors (Ossus)/Legends|group of Jedi]] became trapped in the caves by a collapse in part of the tunnel. Surviving the cataclysm on the surface, these surviving Jedi were the progenitors of the [[Ysanna/Legends|Ysanna]] people that would come to roam the wastes of Ossus and protect its ruins.<ref name="NoP" />
